biography.plain_text: Carlo Pontecorvo is a Naples-born industrialist who leads the mineral-water producer Ferrarelle. A former surgeon, he entered his wife’s family glassmaking business after she was orphaned, initially representing her interests. He subsequently established LGR Holding, which acquired Ferrarelle from Danone, and developed the family’s interests in shipping and other businesses.

long_biography.plain_text:
Carlo Pontecorvo brought a physician’s concern for testing to his leadership of Ferrarelle. He worked with universities to study its naturally effervescent water and regarded laboratory analysis as central to product quality. His medical experience also shaped his approach to managing people, drawing on the attention to individual circumstances he had learnt in hospital practice.

Under his leadership, the company built a plant at Presenzano to turn used plastic bottles into material for new packaging. The plant opened in 2018 and was sold in 2022. A ten-year supply contract allowed Ferrarelle to keep buying bottle preforms from the site.
